dict.string: Murmur listens while you record to turn your voice into text, privately on your Mac.
Murmur listens for the names in your contacts so they’re spelled right when you dictate. Names never leave your Mac.
Murmur transcribes your recordings on your Mac so you can type with your voice.
For meeting notes, Murmur listens to what your Mac plays (the other people on a call) and transcribes it on this Mac. Audio is never saved or sent anywhere.
Commands can play music in Spotify or Music, switch dark mode, and empty the Trash when you ask.
Murmur names your meetings and lists who’s there using your calendar, and adds events when you ask. Your calendar never leaves your Mac.
Murmur adds reminders when you ask, like “remind me to apply to a16z Speedrun tomorrow”. Your reminders never leave your Mac.
